name: brujah
description: a Brujah, a pale bald vampire brute: chalk-white skin, glowing red eyes, fangs, pointed ears and a red scar across the scalp, a bare muscular torso, a black spiked pauldron on his left shoulder, tattered red cloth strips hanging from the shoulder and the belt, a black loincloth, black boots; a huge black double-bladed battle axe with a red-wrapped haft gripped by the end of its haft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the battle axe's haft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand also holds the haft higher up, but during the action it lets go and is an empty clawed fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the haft, the battle axe is lifted beside the head with its double-bladed head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the axe hand behind the head and the battle axe's double-bladed head hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the empty left fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the axe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the battle axe is level, its double-bladed head pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: axe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the battle axe's blades chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the battle axe carries on down until its blades nearly touch the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the tattered red cloth strips trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the battle axe comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the left hand reaching for the haft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, fangs bared, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (axe arm thrown up and out to the left, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the battle axe dipping, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, axe arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the bald head droops, the battle axe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the battle axe's blades resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the battle axe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and the bald head toward the upper-left; the battle axe lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red cloth strips spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red cloth strips settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the battle axe on the ground beside him
